race.comment: MINI EASY (8) missed the frame latest when seventh at Ballarat (26.34) but was a winner four back in the best time of the program. Form here at the trip sound including two wins. Form from her last run is proving strong. Has claims if she runs up to expectations. ALWAYS SPEEDY (4) goes very well this course and distance starting 18 times for six wins and three minors. Comes off a (16.93) win last time, scoring by 2 lengths in a Grade 5 over 300m at this track. With even luck and a clean start should be thereabouts. BE A BEAUTY (2) held her own to the line last start and filled a minor placing, beaten only (17.04) behind ALWAYS SPEEDY at this track. Strong form has emerged from her last run. Bold showing expected. SOMERTON WILLOW (7) has been a model of consistency and deserves plenty of thought.
